summary: Onsite onboarding: ship laptop + peripherals from NYC storage to contractor, provision temp badge and desk handoff
description:
Issue summary:
- New 3-month contractor (Hanna Morales) starting on-site 2026-03-01 needs company laptop and peripherals shipped from NYC storage, a temporary badge valid for first week, and an assigned hot desk on 6th floor.

Impact:
- Contractor cannot access network or desk without badge and machine; onboarding tasks blocked if equipment/shipping delayed. Low company-wide impact but high for team ramp.

Environment:
- NYC office (6th floor), prod access policies enforced by security, asset stored in locked storage room (storage-tag: S-NYC-3).

Steps to reproduce (operational runbook):
1) Verify asset availability in asset management and storage.
2) Create temporary badge entry in Access Control for Hanna Morales (ID pending).
3) Schedule courier pick-up from storage and confirm shipping ETA to front desk.
4) Prepare hot desk: cable, power strip, network port mapping, and label desk with contractor name.
5) On delivery day, CS/Facilities to meet courier, sign chain-of-custody, log serial numbers, and hand off badge and equipment.

Attachments/Links: asset inventory page, onboarding checklist, access-control runbook.
